how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-duskwood-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:453:obj:0: Find the Shadowy Figure. Your clues:
rows.quest:453:obj:1: He is not native to Darkshire.
rows.quest:453:obj:2: He is a nervous, jittery person.
rows.quest:453:obj:3: He left Darkshire and headed west.
rows.quest:453:details:0: Good luck, ⟦1⟧. I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive.
rows.quest:453:details:1: If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.
rows.quest:453:progress:0: Who are you?? Leave me be!
rows.quest:453:completion:1: Yes, I'm the author of that book. You finally found me, eh?
rows.quest:453:completion:2: Well if you read that journal...then you only know the half of it!
rows.quest:57:obj:0: Commander Althea Ebonlocke of Darkshire wants you to kill 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors.

If you're up to the job, journey to the ⟦E3⟧ graveyard and slay 15 of those vile Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors. There are also reports of skeletons just south of Darkshire, in and around Tranquil Gardens Cemetery. The ⟦E2⟧ must be driven from ⟦E4⟧!
rows.quest:57:progress:0: Return to me once you have killed 15 Skeletal Fiends and 15 Skeletal Horrors, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:57:completion:0: The people of Darkshire thank you, ⟦4⟧. You have proven yourself to be a great ally of ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:133:obj:0: Gather 7 Ghoul Ribs and bring them to Abercrombie at his shack.
rows.quest:133:details:0: I live so far from the protection of town, it's a wonder the ghouls and the walking dead haven't eaten me! In fact, just yesterday a pack of Bone Chewers was pounding on the walls of my house!
rows.quest:133:details:1: I want to make an effigy - a kind of "scarecrow" for Ghouls. To do that I need some Ghoul Ribs. You can get them from Flesh Eaters, Bone Chewers, Brain Eaters, Rotted Ones and Plague Spreaders.
rows.quest:133:details:2: Get the ribs for me, and I will repay you with some coin.
rows.quest:133:progress:0: I think I hear a pack of Ghouls scurrying around the back of the house - I better put that effigy up quick! Did you get those Ghoul Ribs for me?
rows.quest:133:completion:0: Ah, thanks. These will do just the trick!
rows.quest:66:obj:0: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
rows.quest:66:details:0: Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins. I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger. I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.
rows.quest:66:details:1: After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery. A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.
rows.quest:66:details:2: Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character. I ⟦E6⟧ for us all.
rows.quest:66:completion:0: Ah so Madame Eva sent you....
rows.quest:67:obj:0: ⟦E7⟧ to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.
rows.quest:67:details:0: Stalvan, eh? Let me check the town registry.
rows.quest:67:details:1: Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see. Ah, here we go! I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle. The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse. My, talk about outdated!
rows.quest:67:details:2: Do me a favor will you, friend? If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow. I like to keep the records clean.
rows.quest:68:obj:0: Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.
rows.quest:68:details:0: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
rows.quest:68:progress:0: Ah, I remember you. You're the one who was asking about that Stalvan fellow. Did you ever find what you were looking for?
rows.quest:68:completion:0: Interesting. So the chap did spend some time in Moonbrook after all. It is rather odd the letter never got delivered. Nonetheless, I shall update the registry.
rows.quest:69:obj:0: Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.
rows.quest:69:details:0: Oh my! Must have missed this the first time. In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out. Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire. Might want to check there, ⟦5⟧.
rows.quest:70:obj:0: Retrieve Stalvan's Undelivered Letter from the chest and deliver it to the Canal District in ⟦E8⟧.
rows.quest:70:details:0: The name Stalvan rings a bell. I remember now.
rows.quest:70:details:1: Many years back, on a stormy night, a messenger came in, seeking refuge for the night. Near the stroke of midnight, the man ran down the stairs screaming, his face pale with ⟦E6⟧. Still wearing his bedclothes, he disappeared into the downpour.
rows.quest:70:details:2: In his haste he forgot his letters in the chest upstairs. He never returned for them. One remains from that Stalvan fellow, intended for the Canal District in ⟦E8⟧. Help yourself to it.
rows.quest:70:progress:0: What have ya got there? Let me take a look at that. . .
rows.quest:70:completion:0: You've got some nerve bringing this here.
rows.quest:72:obj:0: Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.
rows.quest:72:details:0: My father was the caretaker of the estate long before I was. He had to mop the blood up after the massacre. But that's neither here nor there.
rows.quest:72:details:1: The last funds of the Flintridge trust have dried up. Now the last of the family possessions are headed for auction. Blame the tax vultures. I guess if you're really itching to learn more you're free to look through this junk. Who knows what you might find.
rows.quest:72:completion:0: You slowly slide the lid of the crate off. . . .
rows.quest:74:obj:0: The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.
rows.quest:74:details:0: Inside the crate you find various objects: musty heirlooms, a family portrait, a few hunting trophies and some old books. Near the bottom, underneath a ceramic vase, you uncover ⟦E9⟧.
rows.quest:74:progress:0: What have you got there? I cannot see. My eyesight is very bad. Put it in my hands.
rows.quest:74:completion:0: I can barely make out those letters. But that writing style reminds me of something I once saw before my vision became so poor.
rows.quest:75:obj:0: ⟦E10⟧ wants you to check the chest upstairs for the Faded ⟦E11⟧.
rows.quest:75:details:0: There was a bundle of parchments in the chest upstairs when I moved into this place. I looked at them once when I first arrived but I gave up once the fog hazed over my peepers.
rows.quest:75:details:1: Do an old, nearly-blind man a favor and check the chest upstairs for anything that might help you in your quest to discover more about this Stalvan character. I'm pretty sure there's a faded journal page that might be of interest to you. Bring it to me and I'll help in anyway I can.
rows.quest:75:progress:0: Did you find that page I mentioned, ⟦6⟧?
rows.quest:78:obj:0: Take the Faded ⟦E11⟧ to Tavernkeep Smitts.
rows.quest:78:details:0: I know of someone who might be able to assist you. ⟦E12⟧ when I was leading the ⟦E8⟧ Guard, we used to get drinks at the ⟦E13⟧ Raven Tavern in Darkshire. The ⟦E14⟧ there, Smitts, was quite an expert on the local lore. Show him this page and see what he has to say about it.
rows.quest:78:progress:0: ⟦E10⟧ sent you? Why didn't you say so?⟦7⟧⟦8⟧Ah, good ol' Haggard. Poor chap is going to be completely blind before long. Anyway, let me see what you've got there.

rows.quest:79:obj:0: Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.
rows.quest:79:details:0: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years. When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate. I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods. Your trail of evidence proves his guilt. Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
rows.quest:79:progress:0: This better be good, ⟦9⟧. Let me see what you have and tell me your tale. But by the Light, be quick about it. Darkshire's defense is my number one priority. I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.
rows.quest:79:completion:0: My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:80:details:0: I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime. But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt.
rows.quest:80:details:1: In all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting. Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.
rows.quest:80:progress:0: ⟦E12⟧ again, ⟦11⟧? What do you have this time?
rows.quest:80:completion:0: Why yes! The writing on this page does in fact match that of the registry signatures.
rows.quest:97:obj:0: Report the news to Commander Ebonlocke.
rows.quest:97:details:0: Let Commander Ebonlocke know immediately that the handwriting matched, ⟦12⟧! Her suspicions were correct!
rows.quest:173:obj:0: Kill 6 Nightbane ⟦E16⟧ Weaver worgen for Calor in Darkshire.

rows.quest:323:obj:0: Kill 15 Skeletal Raiders, 3 Skeletal Healers and 3 Skeletal Warders, and then return to ⟦E17⟧.

rows.quest:221:completion:2: I will put my faith in Master Carevin. No doubt he will get to the bottom of the problem.
